## Activity

During June 2026, Oakridge Primary Care completed 96 captures. This activity provides the recorded volume for the reporting period and supports monitoring of service delivery at the site. The capture total should continue to be reviewed alongside image quality and grading outcomes to identify any operational issues requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the 96 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1 per cent. The site should continue to monitor image acquisition and record recurring camera issues with the service desk. Timely logging will support investigation of equipment or operating issues and help maintain consistent image quality.

## Grading

There were 20 referable results during June 2026. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates that grading activity was completed within a short timeframe during the reporting period. Oakridge Primary Care should continue to review grading performance and raise any emerging delays through the usual service channels.
